question.text: Meera opens a demat account with a DP. Which of the following is NOT a right she enjoys as a beneficial owner of dematerialised securities?

answer.text: Right to receive dividends and other entitlements
Right to nominate a person to receive securities in case of her death
Right to appoint or remove the Depository Participant's compliance officer

explanation.text: The Logic: A beneficial owner's rights include transacting, receiving dividends/bonus/rights/interest, exercising voting rights, consolidation, transfer, transposition, nomination, pledge, and receiving periodic account information. The appointment or removal of a DP's compliance officer is an internal governance matter of the DP, not an investor right. The Trap: The question tests whether candidates can distinguish between investor rights and DP governance. The other options — dividends, pledge, and nomination — are genuine BO rights. Note: The DP must provide a transaction statement to the beneficial owner at least monthly.
